newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks up in early morning, yen seen settling.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks up in early morning, yen seen settling.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rose slightly in early Monday morning trade as investors continued to seek blue-chip issues due to a belief that recent turbulence in the yen has abated, brokers said.
As of 0019 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was up 89.01 points or 0.44 percent at 20,098.01. Its June futures were up 70 points at 20,100.

"The market should continue the positive mood started late last week," a market analyst at a foreign brokerage said. "But there is little fresh direction and the U.S. and London markets are on holiday, so turnover may shrink."
